intro: Unfortunate News is a quest in WoW Forever following an attempt to contact a defecting cultist. Arriving to find the informant already dead, the adventurer recovers a damaged, glowing blue crystal from the body and delivers it to High Elder Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The turncoat was already dead when you arrived, you say? This is unfortunate news.
You hand over the crystal you found on the dead cultist's body.
